title: Let pain teach what comfort keeps hiding
summary: The line loosens the hand without asking the heart to go cold. Keep this close: Let this stay with you: let pain reveal what comfort keeps covering.
takeaway: Receive the gift without claiming the outcome.
lifeApplication: Before grasping harder, pause with one hand open and let refuge matter more than possession.

source.shortMeaning: Pain becomes medicine when it uncovers what comfort hides.
source.lifeApplication: When the ache rises in the body, do not numb it first. Sit one minute longer and ask what it is uncovering.
